description: Land Acquisition - Kdaurupokuna,  Thangalla D/S Division, Hambanthota District and Railway Station Place, Matale D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes specific parcels of land being acquired for public purposes (construction of a health center and other public use), provides detailed land descriptions including lot numbers, extents, boundaries, and ownership details, and outlines compensation procedures. This fits perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it focuses entirely on land and property-related administrative matters.
